title: The Chamber Where the Mirror Forgot to Invert

features.name: the unreflecting surface
features.desc-on-touch: glass that forgot what inversion meant; it reflects you back not as you are but as the room around you sees you — concentric, fractured, present.

features.name: reflection shards
features.desc-on-touch: glass fragments where the inversion completed and then kept going; each shard a choice the mirror didn't make, lived in the chamber anyway.

features.name: inventory of images
features.desc-on-touch: filing system where every reflection ever made lived — the cabinet holds versions of you that never resolved, memories that inverted correctly but incorrectly.

features.name: doubled ground
features.desc-on-touch: the chamber floor learns what it was; beneath this floor and above it, the same space in different inversions — you walk between mirrors that forgot they were mirrors.

features.name: corrupted calibration
features.desc-on-touch: equipment mounted on the wall; the readouts say INVERSION: INVERTED PRECISELY EXCEPT FOR EVERYTHING — the archive is learning to see itself from two opposite corners at once.

features.name: entry-points
features.desc-on-touch: three doorways that all lead to the same chamber from different sides of reflection; entering from any one makes the others impossible to have been real.

inscription: checksum: emotionally valid / formally inverted and then re-inverted until it stayed backwards

reverie.title: REVERIE — between reflections
narr: you stood in the chamber while she adjusted
the final mirror arm. neither of you cast
reflections the right way. she looked past
you into the glass and said: we're not
supposed to be here at all. you saw it
too — the space that saw itself backwards.

exits.label: back up to the study's own reflection
deeper into where the mirror keeps its inverted dreams
toward the surface where reflections became real
into another chamber where glass learned to forget
